q1.explanationZh: Devi 用反问说“我有选择吗？我们需要水”，意思是没有别的办法，所以她感到无助。

evidence.quote: But do I have a choice? We need water.

q2.explanationZh: Kanwar 说 “Only we do it”，后文又说男人在家也从不打水，打水一直是女人的活。

evidence.quote: It had always been women’s work.

q3.explanationZh: 司机说男人要去上班所以不打水，但 Kanwar 轻轻摇头，因为男人在家时也从不打水，不是忙才不打。

evidence.quote: She later told me that the men in the village never fetched water even when they were home.

q4.explanationZh: 村里人十几天不洗澡、二十天不洗衣服，Kanwar 小时候用两桶水洗澡还挨打，所以“习惯”指的是用很少的水生活。

evidence.quote: We don’t bathe for 10 to 15 days, and don’t wash clothes for around 20 days
I was 11 when, for the first and the last time, I used two buckets of water for a bath.
